item.description:
Flow runs for an hour. Its row is now a button like Breathe's: click to start, watch the minutes count down, click again to stop early. The hour ends with a fade. Breathe and Flow are both out of beta, and each one's settings row now has "Read the research" — what the sound does and the studies behind it.

Control+Option+Backspace deletes what you just said — the whole insertion, in one press. And the key you press to cancel a dictation no longer types into your document.

Redraft works after a quiet spell. It loads the model itself instead of declining, and it keeps the shorter rewrites it used to throw away — losing the lead-in and the stutters is the point.

Fixed: with the Coding pack loaded, a spoken "C" came out as "C#++".
